dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどいういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 不妊の事で悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm struggling with infertility.

dialogue.origin: それは大事な問題ですよね
dialogue.content: That's a very important issue, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 状況お聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about your situation?

dialogue.origin: 毎月毎月、検査して出来て居ないと絶望します
dialogue.content: Every single month I take a test, and when it’s negative, I feel devastated.

dialogue.origin: はい、それはとても辛いですよね。。
dialogue.content: Yes, that must be very painful...

dialogue.origin: どれくらい前から検査はしているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How long have you been testing?

dialogue.origin: 2年前からです
dialogue.content: For two years now.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。長い間頑張られてきたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You've been trying so hard for a long time.

dialogue.origin: 母や父、近所の方たちからもまだかまだかと急かされ辛いです
dialogue.content: My mother, my father, and even my neighbors keep rushing me, asking, "Not yet?" It's very hard.

dialogue.origin: それはプレッシャーを感じてますますしんどくなりますよね。。
dialogue.content: That must make you feel even more pressure and distress...

dialogue.origin: はい、プレッシャーです
dialogue.content: Yes, it's a lot of pressure.

dialogue.origin: ご主人は何とおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.content: What does your husband say about it?

dialogue.origin: 主人は最近、非協力的でそんなに欲しいなら他の男とやってこい！などと言われました
dialogue.content: Lately, my husband has been uncooperative and even said things like, 'If you want it that badly, go do it with another man!'

dialogue.origin: えーっ、そんなことを・・・
dialogue.content: Oh my, he said that to you...

dialogue.origin: お子さんについては、夫婦間で考え方が違うということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: When it comes to having children, do you and your husband see things differently?

dialogue.origin: 次の子が欲しい気持ちは同じですが、主人は誰からも責められないので私の気持ちを理解してくれません
dialogue.content: We both feel the same about wanting another child, but since no one blames him, he doesn't understand how I feel.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。理解してもらえないととても悲しい気持ちになりますよね。。
dialogue.content: I see. It must be very sad when you feel he doesn't understand...

dialogue.origin: はい私だけが周りから急かされ責められ
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm the only one being pressured and blamed by everyone around me...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I hear you.

dialogue.origin: 別れようかとも思いましたが、こんな私と結婚してくれた本当は優しい人なんです
dialogue.content: I've even thought about leaving him, but he's a kind person deep down for marrying someone like me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ご主人のことをとても愛しておられるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you love your husband very much.

dialogue.origin: 一人目のお子さんはおいくつですか？
dialogue.content: How old is your first child?

dialogue.origin: 愛しているかは今は分からなくなってますが、こんな私と結婚してくれたので負い目はあります
dialogue.content: I'm not sure if I love him anymore, but I feel indebted because he married someone like me.

dialogue.origin: 3歳です
dialogue.content: Three years old.

dialogue.origin: すみません被ってしまいました
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, our messages overlapped.

dialogue.origin: いえ
dialogue.content: No problem.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: 三歳ですね、有難うございます。
dialogue.content: Three years old, I see. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 三歳のお子さんがおられてですと、どんな感じで日々お過ごしでしょうか？
dialogue.content: With a three-year-old child, what is a typical day like for you?

dialogue.origin: 朝から家族5人分の食事を作り、幼稚園に送り、仕事をし幼稚園のお迎えに行き、また家事をし、自分の時間は全くなく、最近体調も良くないです
dialogue.content: From the morning, I make meals for our family of five, drop my child off at kindergarten, go to work, pick them up from kindergarten, and then do more housework. I have no time for myself at all, and I haven't been feeling well lately.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。忙しすぎて気が休まらないですよね。。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds so busy that you never get a moment's rest...

dialogue.origin: はい主人は仕事が終わるとゲームばかりで家事も子供の面倒もみてくれず腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: Yes, when my husband gets home from work, all he does is play video games. He doesn't help with housework or look after our child, and it makes me so angry.

dialogue.origin: その状況ですと、ほんとに怒りが込み上げてきますよね。
dialogue.content: In that situation, it's completely understandable that you'd feel a surge of anger.

dialogue.origin: はい！自分で出来るような事まで用事を増やすしやってられないです
dialogue.content: Yes! He even creates more chores for me that he could easily do himself. I can't take it anymore.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: なんでわたしばっかり！ってなりますよね
dialogue.content: It makes you feel like, "Why is it always me!?" doesn't it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです！
dialogue.content: Exactly!

dialogue.origin: 家族5人ということですが、ご自身とご主人、3歳のお子さん、以外はどなたがおられるのですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned a family of five; besides you, your husband, and the three-year-old, who else is there?

dialogue.origin: 私の母と父です実家暮らしなのですが、両親には迷惑かけてばかりで…
dialogue.content: My mother and father. We're living with my parents, but I feel like I'm nothing but a burden to them...

dialogue.origin: ご両親に対しては、肩身の狭い感じなのですね。。
dialogue.content: So you feel like you're in an awkward position with your parents.

dialogue.origin: ご主人とご両親は普段どんな関わりをされていますか？
dialogue.content: How do your husband and your parents usually interact?

dialogue.origin: はい主人の両親には結婚を反対され実家が私を家に住まわせてくれ主人にも仕事をくれお給料も払ってくれてます
dialogue.content: Yes... My husband's parents were against our marriage, so my parents let us live with them, gave my husband a job, and even pay him a salary.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあって、苦労されてのご結婚だったのですね。。
dialogue.content: So you went through all that... It must have been a very difficult marriage to begin with.

dialogue.origin: はい私は皆に迷惑かけてばかりです
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm just causing trouble for everyone.

dialogue.origin: 迷惑かけてる、そんなふうに感じているのですね。。
dialogue.content: You feel like you're causing trouble, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい私の選択に皆を振り回してるような気がしてます
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel like my choices are disrupting everyone's lives.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。とても周りに対して申し訳ない気持ちになっているのですね。。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you feel very guilty towards everyone around you.

dialogue.origin: はい、だから皆が責めても仕方ないんです
dialogue.content: Yes, so it can't be helped if everyone blames me.

dialogue.origin: ご主人の両親に結婚を反対されたのは、何かあったのでしょうか？（お話しできる範囲で結構です）
dialogue.content: Was there a specific reason your husband's parents opposed the marriage? (You only need to share what you're comfortable with.)

dialogue.origin: 私と付き合う前にお付き合いしていた彼女の方が向こうの両親は好きらしく私をとても嫌ってこの女と結婚するなら親子の縁を切る。と言われて結婚式にも来てくれませんでした
dialogue.content: His parents apparently preferred his previous girlfriend. They disliked me so much that they told him, "If you marry that woman, we'll disown you." They didn't even come to our wedding.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったのですね。それはとても悲しいですよね。。
dialogue.content: That's what happened... That must have been incredibly sad.

dialogue.origin: ええ、とても孫に会って貰いたいですがそれも叶わずにいます
dialogue.content: Yes. I really want them to meet their grandchild, but that hasn't happened either.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、、それは心苦しいですよね。。
dialogue.content: I see... That must be heartbreaking.

dialogue.origin: はい、私のせいで皆が不幸です
dialogue.content: Yes. Because of me, everyone is unhappy.

dialogue.origin: 少し戻りますが、ご自身は二人目のお子さんを作るということについて、どんな風に感じておられますか？
dialogue.content: If we can go back a little, how do you personally feel about having a second child?

dialogue.origin: 周りの期待に応える為にも長女に下の子を作ってあげたいのと何より2人目の赤ちゃんを早く抱きたいです
dialogue.content: I want to have a younger sibling for my eldest daughter, partly to meet everyone's expectations, but more than anything, I just want to hold a second baby soon.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。家族が増えるのを心待ちにされているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you're eagerly looking forward to growing your family.

dialogue.origin: はい、赤ちゃんはかわいいですし、特に周りの期待に応えないと
dialogue.content: Yes, babies are adorable, and... I especially feel I have to live up to everyone's expectations.

dialogue.origin: 周りの期待をとても大きく感じておられるのですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like you feel the weight of those expectations very heavily.

dialogue.origin: ええ、顔があえばまだかまだかと。プレッシャーです
dialogue.content: Yes, whenever I see them, it's always "not yet, not yet?" It's so much pressure.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話を少し整理させていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I took a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 2人目のお子さんが欲しいけれども、なかなかうまくいかず悩んでおられます
dialogue.content: You want a second child, but you're struggling because it hasn't been happening.

dialogue.origin: ご主人は最近は協力してくれなくなっていて、普段の生活も忙しく体調もすぐれない状態です
dialogue.content: Your husband has become uncooperative recently, and on top of that, your daily life is very busy and you're not feeling well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 実家のご両親には、結婚時の選択で迷惑をかけているように感じられており、
dialogue.content: You feel you’ve burdened your parents with the choices you made around your marriage,

dialogue.origin: ご主人のご両親には結婚を反対され、なんとか孫を抱かせてあげたいがそれもかなわない状況です。
dialogue.content: and your husband’s parents opposed the marriage; you’d like to let them hold their grandchild, but that hasn’t been possible.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なんだか、自分のせいで周りに迷惑ばかりかけているように感じておられ、とても苦しくどうしたらいいのか悩んでおられる。このように受けとめましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It seems you feel like you're causing trouble for everyone because of your choices, and you're in a lot of pain, unsure of what to do. Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.origin: はい、その通りです
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s exactly right.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お話を聞いていて、ご自身は　とても周囲への気づかいができる素晴らしい方だと思いました。
dialogue.content: As I was listening to you, I was struck by what a wonderful and considerate person you are towards those around you.

dialogue.origin: いえ、感謝はしてますが主人には不満でいっぱいになる時もあります
dialogue.content: No... I am grateful, but there are times I'm filled with frustration towards my husband.

dialogue.origin: それだけ頑張っておられるのですから、なんで私だけとなるのは当然だと思います
dialogue.content: You're trying so hard, so it's only natural to feel, "Why is it always me?"

dialogue.origin: そうでしょうか…
dialogue.content: Do you think so...?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ただ、
dialogue.content: However,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 周りへの気遣いがおできになる分、二人目のお子さんの妊娠を逆にプレッシャーに感じてしまっておられるのだと思います。
dialogue.content: Because you are so considerate of others, I imagine trying for a second child is, conversely, becoming a source of pressure.

dialogue.origin: 周りの方への思いが強い分、期待に応えないといけないという思いが強すぎるのではないかと、私は感じました
dialogue.content: I felt that because your feelings for those around you are so strong, your need to meet their expectations might be too overwhelming.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that resonate with you?

dialogue.origin: あれだけ沢山の人に顔を合わせる度に聞かれればこんな気持ちにもなります言わないで欲しいです
dialogue.content: When so many people ask me every time I see them, of course I'd feel this way. I just wish they'd stop.

dialogue.origin: 確かにそうですよね。こんなに頑張っているのに何で！って気持ちになりますよね。。
dialogue.content: You're absolutely right. It must make you feel, "I'm trying so hard, so why is this happening!?"

dialogue.origin: はい！！
dialogue.content: Yes!!

dialogue.origin: すみません、時間オーバーしてしまいました
dialogue.content: I’m sorry—we’ve gone over time.

dialogue.origin: 本日は有難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for today.

topic.sub: 夫婦間のコミュニケーションの不足とプレッシャー
